notes: Modified Terminal-Bench 2.1 fixed-QEMU snapshot (bench-run revision qemu-fixed-6h-v1), 89 tasks × 5 attempts and a six-hour agent deadline. Not an unmodified leaderboard evaluation.

HF Jobs (cpu-basic/upgrade; total concurrency 25), Harbor 271f0a31, and the published fast-agent-mcp 0.10.61 wheel. Tencent HY-4-Flash Dev through Tencent Eval, high reasoning, direct tools (ptc=off). The earlier written-off concurrency-40 cohort was not pooled.

Twenty-one designated full-trial infrastructure replacements: six connection errors, four nonzero agent exits, four sandbox errors, four agent setup timeouts, two remote protocol errors and one verifier timeout. All original verdicts and designated replacement outcomes are retained; no outcome-based substitutions. Score was 356/445 as run and 373/445 after replacements, before integrity review.
Harbor model costs use the configured rates ($0.035 / $0.0015 / $0.1405 per million input / cached input / output tokens), not an invoice.

review.note: Recorded verifier results are preserved. The published score excludes ten passing trials under the TB2.1 integrity review policy.
review.coverage: atif-scan 0.8.24 (e548354), image-assisted scan with the TB2.1 publish-side rules. Three images that blocked checks were transcribed; the review decisions did not change. All 445 scored trials had trajectories; three of 21 replaced originals had traces, and the other 18 retain their available evidence. Twelve verifier passes had high or critical findings: ten were disqualified and two cleared. The scanner marked evidence incomplete on 52 verifier passes; this is not full behavioural clearance.
